description: T-5358 (the column axis; table-delete-all-columns answers a delete of exactly the table's columns): one delete_column of A:D (count 4), more columns than the table holds, from the column left of it to the column right of it. Table Sales on S!B3:C7 (headers Region/Qty, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8), S!A4 'left' and S!H4 'right' (table-delete-all-columns's layout). Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =COLUMNS(Sales), A4 =ROWS(Sales), A5 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A6 =SUM(S!C4:C7), A7 FORMULATEXT(A6), A8 =COUNTA(Sales[Region]), A9 =COLUMN(Sales[Qty]), A10 =ISREF(Sales), A11 =S!H4, A12 FORMULATEXT(A11) (how far the cells right of the table move).
